name: _Table Row
description: Private semantic record row for Table. It preserves the four fixed cell roles and contextual selected presentation while leaving actual interaction to descendant controls.

props.name: primary
props.description: Primary record content supplied by Table row data.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Secondary record content supplied by Table row data.

props.name: status
props.description: Status record content supplied by Table row data, typically a governed Status Badge.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional Action-region content supplied by Table row data, typically a governed Button or passive no-action content.

props.name: selected
props.description: Contextual selected-record presentation supplied by parent/list-detail state. It is not a checkbox or bulk-selection model.

anatomy.name: row
anatomy.description: Native tr record row; the row itself is not a click target.

anatomy.name: primary
anatomy.description: Primary td taking remaining inline space.

anatomy.name: secondary
anatomy.description: Secondary td with reviewed 100px content width.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Status td with reviewed 160px content width.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Action td with reviewed 128px content width; its content may be absent.

states.name: hover
states.description: CSS pointer-hover presentation aids scanning while the row remains non-interactive.

states.name: selected
states.description: Parent-supplied contextual detail association. Selected is visual record context, not bulk selection.

semantics.element: native tr containing exactly four td cells
semantics.accessibleName: Cell content and descendant governed controls retain their own semantics and names; the row adds no hidden activation label.
semantics.keyboardActivation: none at row level; only genuine descendant controls are keyboard interactive
semantics.focus: The row itself never becomes focusable. Focus remains on descendant controls such as the Action button.
requirements: Each row renders exactly four native td cells in Primary / Secondary / Status / Action order.
Primary can wrap and grow row height. Secondary / Status / Action preserve the reviewed 100px / 160px / 128px content widths.
The row has a 60px reviewed minimum height, 6px block inset, 20px inline table inset, shared 24px / 24px / 8px inter-region gaps, and a subtle bottom divider.

selected=true uses the reviewed selected surface and only associates the record with open detail context. It does not create checkbox, radio, aria-selected grid semantics, onSelect, or bulk-selection behavior.

Hover is CSS-derived and cannot be supplied as a public state value. The live Figma set reviewed on 2026-09-18 contains only default / hover / selected variants; stale wording about six variants or two rendering orders does not establish an order API.
The entire row never becomes an implicit activation target. The Action region owns actual controls and repeated controls need meaningful product-supplied accessible names.
The helper remains private and must not appear in the public React barrel or package exports.

content.description: Private row anatomy configured from public Table row data.
